title: Foreign-applicant requirements need confirmation
summary: The official BA page rendered successfully on 3 October and showed domestic requirements, but no foreign-applicant section was visible. Missing content does not resolve foreign or NRI eligibility.
requiredReview: Confirm current foreign and NRI admission requirements before proposing a complete eligibility correction. Do not copy another Amity program’s criteria.

title: Official eligibility sources differ
summary: The program page and 2026–27 prospectus retain compulsory-mathematics wording. The programme project report adds 50% marks (45% for reserved categories) without repeating that condition. Rechecked on 3 October; the conflict remains unresolved.
requiredReview: Obtain current admissions confirmation of mathematics prerequisites and marks for each route and applicant category. Omitted conditions must not be treated as waivers.
